# THE DEPRESSION (USA scope). temp wif_usa_dd = change.
wif_usa_dep_change = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_country_flag = wif_usa_sec
			check_variable = { wif_usa_dd > 10 }
		}
		set_temp_variable = { wif_usa_dd = 10 }
	}
	add_to_variable = { wif_usa_dep = wif_usa_dd }
	clamp_variable = { var = wif_usa_dep min = 0 max = 100 }
	wif_usa_dep_update = yes
}
wif_usa_dep_update = {
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { wif_usa_dep < 0.5 } }
		set_variable = { wif_usa_dep = 0 }
		if = {
			limit = { has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = wif_usa_great_depression } }
			remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = wif_usa_great_depression }
		}
	}
	else = {
		set_variable = { wif_usa_dep_stab = wif_usa_dep }
		multiply_variable = { wif_usa_dep_stab = -0.0015 }
		set_variable = { wif_usa_dep_fac = wif_usa_dep }
		multiply_variable = { wif_usa_dep_fac = -0.002 }
		set_variable = { wif_usa_dep_cg = wif_usa_dep }
		multiply_variable = { wif_usa_dep_cg = 0.0015 }
		set_variable = { wif_usa_dep_build = wif_usa_dep }
		multiply_variable = { wif_usa_dep_build = -0.001 }
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = wif_usa_great_depression } } }
			add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = wif_usa_great_depression }
		}
	}
}
# Game start: vanilla's Great Depression ideas give way to THE DEPRESSION.
wif_usa_dep_start = {
	if = { limit = { has_idea = great_depression } remove_ideas = great_depression }
	if = { limit = { has_idea = great_depression_2 } remove_ideas = great_depression_2 }
	if = { limit = { has_idea = great_depression_3 } remove_ideas = great_depression_3 }
	if = {
		limit = { date > 1938.12.31 }
		set_variable = { wif_usa_dep = 45 }
	}
	else = {
		set_variable = { wif_usa_dep = 80 }
	}
	wif_usa_dep_update = yes
}
wif_usa_monthly = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_country_flag = wif_usa_reform
			check_variable = { wif_usa_dep > 0 }
		}
		set_temp_variable = { wif_usa_dd = -1 }
		wif_usa_dep_change = yes
	}
}
